sections.title: Reliability and Performance by Design
sections.body: Engineering excellence is the cornerstone of the Kenya AI Compute project. We understand that for data scientists and infrastructure leads, the 'magic' of AI disappears if the underlying hardware is unstable or poorly networked. This section addresses the specific engineering questions raised by our technical partners during due diligence. We provide transparency on our choice of networking fabrics, our approach to managing GPU thermals in the Kenyan climate, and our electrical failover protocols. Our facility is designed to support the next generation of 'high-voltage' AI chips, ensuring that we can host H100 and B200 clusters without power or cooling bottlenecks. If your specific technical query isn't covered here, our NOC engineers are available in our developer Discord for direct consultation. sections.title: Top Engineering Queries
items: Network Fabric: Do you support RDMA/RoCE v2? (Yes, standard for all GPU clusters).
Rack Density: What is the maximum kW per cabinet? (Up to 40kW in specialized modules).
Cooling Type: Do you use immersion cooling? (Not in Phase 1; planned for Phase 3).
PDU Monitoring: Can I see my energy usage per server? (Yes, via the Customer Portal).
Data Security: How is the physical disk disposal handled? (NIST 800-88 compliant wiping/shredding).
